title: Episode 30
logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 29 where Juliana was locked away in the castle's subterranean wet cells, vowing never to let them take Alexander from her.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Accusatory):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:08.80) | End: (00:13.30)
"You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it."

Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:16.90)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:13.50) | End: (00:16.90)
Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.

blocks.speaker: RUPERT (Defensive, Anxious):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:13.60) | End: (00:16.80)
"The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there."

Start: (00:16.90) | End: (00:26.00)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:16.90) | End: (00:26.00)
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Disapproving):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:17.30) | End: (00:25.80)
"The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates."

Start: (00:26.00) | End: (00:29.80)
Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:26.00) | End: (00:29.80)
Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.

blocks.speaker: RUPERT (Muttered, Paranoid):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:26.50) | End: (00:29.20)
"She knows the Duchess was poisoned."

Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:32.00)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:29.80) | End: (00:32.00)
Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:32.00) | End: (00:33.40)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:32.00) | End: (00:33.40)
Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

blocks.speaker: RUPERT (Fearful):
blocks.text:

Start: (00:33.40) | End: (00:39.80)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:33.40) | End: (00:39.80)
Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.

blocks.text:

The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:33.40) | End: (00:35.20)
The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:33.60) | End: (00:39.80)
"Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"

Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:43.80)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:39.80) | End: (00:43.80)
Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

blocks.speaker: RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:41.80) | End: (00:43.50)
"What are you suggesting?"

Start: (00:43.80) | End: (00:47.60)
Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:43.80) | End: (00:47.60)
Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:44.80) | End: (00:47.30)
"We stop hiding the prisoner."

Start: (00:47.60) | End: (00:51.00)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:47.60) | End: (00:51.00)
Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.

blocks.action:

The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.

blocks.text:

Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:51.00) | End: (00:54.60)
Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadpan, Sinister):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:51.20) | End: (00:54.00)
"We give them a reason to condemn her."

Start: (00:54.60) | End: (00:58.80)

Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Inquiring, Sharp):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:57.00) | End: (00:58.80)
"You have a solution?"

Start: (00:58.80) | End: (01:02.80)
Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:58.80) | End: (01:02.80)
Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:59.40) | End: (01:02.50)
"We use the law to destroy her."

Start: (01:02.80) | End: (01:04.80)
Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:02.80) | End: (01:04.80)
Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:04.80) | End: (01:13.50)
Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.
blocks.camera:

Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Pragmatic, Scheming):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:05.30) | End: (01:12.80)
"A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber."

Start: (01:10.80) | End: (01:13.20)
The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.
blocks.action:
Start: (01:10.80) | End: (01:13.20)
The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:13.50) | End: (01:14.80)
Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:13.50) | End: (01:14.80)
Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:14.80) | End: (01:22.80)
Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:14.80) | End: (01:22.80)
Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:15.00) | End: (01:22.50)
"Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner."

Start: (01:22.80) | End: (01:25.60)

blocks.camera:
Start: (01:22.80) | End: (01:25.60)
Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Curious, Conniving):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:23.20) | End: (01:25.40)
"And if she claims she is a healer?"

Start: (01:25.60) | End: (01:28.50)
Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:25.60) | End: (01:28.50)
Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Sinister):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:25.80) | End: (01:27.80)
"Then call it witchcraft."

Start: (01:28.50) | End: (01:31.80)
Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:28.50) | End: (01:31.80)
Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.

blocks.speaker: RUPERT (Stunned):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:29.00) | End: (01:31.30)
"Witchcraft is a capital charge."

Start: (01:31.80) | End: (01:34.50)
Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:31.80) | End: (01:34.50)
Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:34.50) | End: (01:41.90)
Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:34.50) | End: (01:41.90)
Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Command):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:34.60) | End: (01:41.80)
"Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her."

Start: (01:41.90) | End: (01:44.40)
Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:41.90) | End: (01:44.40)
Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Scheming):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:42.20) | End: (01:43.90)
"Her botanical ledger..."

Start: (01:44.40) | End: (01:46.60)
Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:44.40) | End: (01:46.60)
Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:46.60) | End: (01:49.00)
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:46.60) | End: (01:49.00)
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Inquiring):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:47.30) | End: (01:48.80)
"And the Dowager?"

Start: (01:49.00) | End: (01:56.80)
Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:49.00) | End: (01:56.80)
Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Dismissive):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:49.50) | End: (01:56.50)
"She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."

Start: (01:56.80) | End: (02:01.90)
Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:56.80) | End: (02:01.90)
Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.

blocks.speaker: RUPERT (Hesitant):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:00.00) | End: (02:01.50)
"And Juliana?"

Start: (02:01.90) | End: (02:05.10)
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:01.90) | End: (02:05.10)
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:02.40) | End: (02:04.90)
"She goes before the magistrate tomorrow."

Start: (02:05.10) | End: (02:13.50)
Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:05.10) | End: (02:13.50)
Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Cruel, Exultant):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:05.50) | End: (02:13.00)
"She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose."

Start: (02:13.50) | End: (02:16.80)
Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:13.50) | End: (02:16.80)
Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.

blocks.speaker: RUPERT (Resolute, Vengeful):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:14.10) | End: (02:16.20)
"I will write the arrest warrant myself."

Start: (02:16.80) | End: (02:24.50)
Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:16.80) | End: (02:24.50)
Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.

blocks.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Chilling, Decisive):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:17.50) | End: (02:23.50)
"Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch."
